text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 11 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Russian government has ordered to all consumer goods to be marked with quality certificates.
- A reshuffle of top military officials and the first measures on army reform are expected to be announced after the June 25 meeting of Russia's Defence Council.
- Russian peacekeepers will remain in Abhkazia, a breakaway region of Georgia, at least until August 1.
- Moscow authorities have set up a fund for banks and commercial firms to provide financial support for Moscow's Tretyakov art gallery.
- The Moscow city council has started a fight against prostitution in the capital.
